description: Get latest soil sensor readings (moisture, temperature, EC) for a vineyard block. Use for current conditions.

configuration.query: FROM vineyard-soil | WHERE block_id == ?block_id | SORT timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1 | KEEP block_id, block_name, soil_moisture_pct, soil_temp_6in_c, electrical_conductivity, depth_cm, air_temp_c, precip_mm, timestamp
